text: Been waiting over an hour for a call back now. My daughter's 10, she's got chickenpox, spots everywhere and she's itching like mad. Temp's 38.5. Apart from that she's fine, eating, moaning about being bored. No fits or shaking or anything like that. I literally just want to know what I can put on the spots so she can sleep and whether the temperature is normal with chickenpox. It shouldn't take this long.
